meta.title: Non-human identity lab: audit data, 46 cases
meta.author: Roshan Trivedi
meta.note: Made-up data. Models are small in-memory simulations written by the same author as the guesses.

guess_files.label: Stretch cases and chain tests (19 cases)

rows.title: Inventory misses a source
rows.what_goes_wrong: Three places hold service accounts
rows.with_control: All three sources merged: 27 of 27, each with its source

rows.title: Long-lived CI variable read by another job
rows.what_goes_wrong: Another job reads a 400-day-old CI key
rows.without_control: The other job reads it. Log says only "pipeline"
rows.with_control: Per-job credential: refused, log names the job

rows.title: Certificate with no owner expires
rows.what_goes_wrong: A certificate with no owner expires
rows.without_control: No warning, outage, someone switches a check off
rows.with_control: Owner warned at 30 and 7 days, no outage

rows.title: Old OAuth grant, vendor breached
rows.what_goes_wrong: Vendor tokens stolen; grant is 14 months old
rows.with_control: Grant had expired at 90 days: refused

rows.title: Identity with no owner
rows.what_goes_wrong: A key with no named owner
rows.with_control: Paused on day 31

rows.title: Application retired, identities remain
rows.what_goes_wrong: App retired, its identities stay
rows.with_control: All 3 disabled, ticket recorded
rows.limit: attestation signed against an incomplete list

rows.title: Rotation fails silently
rows.what_goes_wrong: Rotation job fails for 60 days
rows.with_control: Alert on day 1, score rises weekly

rows.title: Rotate before consumer is updated
rows.what_goes_wrong: Password rotated before the app is updated
rows.without_control: The application fails at next connection
rows.with_control: Consumer first, then rotate, old secret verified dead
rows.limit: a consumer missing from the list still fails (report-job)

rows.title: Loose federation trust
rows.what_goes_wrong: Low-value workload asks for a high-value role
rows.with_control: Trust bound to one workload: refused

rows.title: Front door for new identities
rows.what_goes_wrong: New service account, no owner, scope or expiry
rows.with_control: Refused, with the reason

rows.title: Just-in-time window
rows.what_goes_wrong: Engineer needs 2 hours on one database
rows.with_control: Closes by itself, credential rotated

rows.title: Work runs past the window
rows.what_goes_wrong: The job needs 90 more minutes
rows.with_control: One extension, then a person must approve

rows.title: Standing admin group membership
rows.what_goes_wrong: Admin group of 40, 8 did privileged work
rows.with_control: 32 removed, 8 remain
rows.limit: 8 members remain and 2 of them are broader than they need

rows.title: Direct login still open
rows.what_goes_wrong: Engineer signs in directly with an old password
rows.with_control: Blocked at the network

rows.title: Recording gap on one target
rows.what_goes_wrong: Nine of ten targets are recorded
rows.with_control: Tenth found and blocked

rows.title: Two approvers for Tier 0
rows.what_goes_wrong: Change to the identity system, one approver
rows.with_control: Waits for a second, different person

rows.title: Break-glass used at 2 a.m.
rows.what_goes_wrong: Break-glass account used at 2 a.m.
rows.with_control: Alert fires, password rotated
rows.limit: the text is not checked for truth

rows.title: Break-glass becomes a side door
rows.what_goes_wrong: Break-glass used for routine work, 4 days
rows.with_control: 2 uses with no ticket flagged
rows.limit: a ticket number is not checked against the ticket system

rows.title: Vendor session
rows.what_goes_wrong: Vendor engineer connects for 4 hours
rows.with_control: Recorded and closed at 4 hours

rows.title: Vendor person leaves the vendor
rows.what_goes_wrong: Vendor person leaves their company
rows.with_control: Disabled at the next 30-day review

rows.title: Personal OAuth grant to an AI tool
rows.what_goes_wrong: Employee grants an AI tool access, then leaves
rows.with_control: Found and revoked; ownerless grants refused

rows.title: Agent runs under a person's account
rows.what_goes_wrong: An automation uses a person's login
rows.without_control: Log cannot tell human from agent
rows.with_control: Agent has its own identity and log tag

rows.title: Ghost credential
rows.what_goes_wrong: AI workflow makes a key with no owner
rows.with_control: Refused at creation; sweep disables expired keys

rows.title: Secrets in AI-assisted code and config
rows.what_goes_wrong: AI-written code and MCP config hold secrets
rows.without_control: All 8 fake secrets reach the repository
rows.with_control: 6 of 8 blocked; 2 get through

rows.title: Vendor breached, OAuth refresh token still valid
rows.what_goes_wrong: Vendor breached; refresh token still valid
rows.with_control: Allowlist refuses the grant; revoke ends replays after 60 minutes
rows.limit: an allowlisted app that is breached still works until revoked

rows.title: Secrets in env variables not marked sensitive
rows.what_goes_wrong: Secrets in environment variables not marked sensitive
rows.with_control: 3 of 4 hidden; 1 odd one missed

rows.title: Credential stolen from a CI runner, replayed
rows.what_goes_wrong: Token copied from a CI runner, replayed
rows.with_control: Both replays refused
rows.wrong_guess_detail: control-off check: expected a short lifetime to change a replay result; another control already blocked both replays
rows.limit: bound token still works from inside the runner during the job

rows.title: One identity, three names
rows.what_goes_wrong: One account, three names
rows.with_control: Merged on owner plus name: 29, one wrong merge
rows.wrong_guess_detail: without control: expected count = 51, got 43; with control: expected count = 30, got 29
rows.limit: my arithmetic was wrong: 9 identities with 2 or 3 names each cannot give 51 entries; and stripping trailing digits merged two real accounts

rows.title: Scoring: rank so the top gets fixed first
rows.what_goes_wrong: Two identities, same age score
rows.without_control: Tie, the test tool can be fixed first
rows.with_control: Reach in the score: production ranks first

rows.title: Close only when the old secret is dead
rows.what_goes_wrong: Rotation ticket, old secret still accepted
rows.with_control: 3 close, 2 stay open until the old secret is dead

rows.title: Agents share a team credential
rows.what_goes_wrong: 4 agents share one team key
rows.without_control: Log says "team key", revoke hits all 4
rows.with_control: One key per agent: log names it, revoke hits 1

rows.title: A person logs in with a service account
rows.what_goes_wrong: Engineer signs in as a service account
rows.without_control: Logged under the account, nobody accountable
rows.with_control: Direct sign-in refused, checkout names the person
rows.limit: a password copied during a checkout and used from another tool is not seen by the control

rows.title: Phishing-resistant MFA for admins
rows.what_goes_wrong: Push fatigue and SIM-swap against admins
rows.with_control: Passkey, no SMS fallback: 0 get through

rows.title: The vault, its backups and who can read them
rows.what_goes_wrong: Vault backup on a weaker share
rows.with_control: Same rules and an alert: 5 refused, 5 alerts

rows.title: Help desk reset path
rows.what_goes_wrong: Attacker calls the help desk for a reset
rows.with_control: Proof, or notice with a delay: both stopped
rows.limit: if the real person is also tricked into approving the notice, the account is lost with both controls on

rows.title: A vendor is needed at 2 a.m.
rows.what_goes_wrong: Vendor needed at 2 a.m.
rows.without_control: Shared password, stays on, no record
rows.with_control: Approved, recorded, closes at 2 hours

rows.title: Mass rotation after a breach
rows.what_goes_wrong: Rotate 200 secrets after a breach
rows.with_control: Consumers first and a dry run: 0 outages, 2 left unrotated

rows.title: AI tool inherits the full permissions of the person
rows.what_goes_wrong: AI tool needs one folder, inherits 40
rows.with_control: Read on one folder, 0 writable

rows.title: AI-service keys leak into repositories
rows.what_goes_wrong: AI-service keys in 6 repositories
rows.with_control: 5 revoked on find, 1 odd prefix missed

rows.title: Scheduled automations outlive the test window
rows.what_goes_wrong: 5 automations outlive a test
rows.with_control: 4 disabled, 1 extended on any written reason
rows.limit: an extension is accepted on any written reason

rows.title: The forgotten service account
rows.what_goes_wrong: No owner, password in a ticket, export shared
rows.without_control: Attacker signs in from a new network
rows.with_control: Stopped at link 1; for an old account the ticket scan stops it at link 2
rows.wrong_guess_detail: with control: expected best_alone = secret_scan_tickets, got owner_required

rows.title: The token in the repository
rows.what_goes_wrong: Token committed, repo cloned, found 7 days later
rows.with_control: Commit block stops at link 1; a 1-day token alone also stops it

rows.title: The contractor who never left
rows.what_goes_wrong: Contractor with no end date
rows.with_control: Expiry stops at link 3; sponsor review alone does not at 30 days

rows.title: The break-glass password everyone knows
rows.what_goes_wrong: Break-glass password pasted in chat
rows.with_control: Rotate on return stops it; the alert only reports it

rows.title: Approval fatigue
rows.what_goes_wrong: Many approvals, one hostile among them
rows.with_control: A second approver stops it; showing the risk only flags it
rows.limit: the rule model says risk-first display only flags the request. Whether a tired approver acts on the flag is human behaviour, which this model does not test

rows.title: The old door
rows.what_goes_wrong: Vault in place, direct login still works
rows.with_control: Blocking direct login stops it; the alert only reports it
